Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This API is called by the ECU Firmware to start the Check Wakeup Timer for the corresponding Wakeup Source. If Ecu MCheck Wakeup Timeout > 0 the Check Wakeup Timer for the Wakeup Source is started. If Ecu MCheck Wakeup Timeout <= 0 the API call is ignored by the Ecu M. Available via Ecu M_ Externals.h
